title: The Lily Pads
text: Lily pads as big as rafts cover a grey lake from shore to shore. On each one sits a frog the size of a hound, throat pulsing, eyes like brass coins, watching you. Every so often one snaps up a passing heron and swallows it whole.

options.label: Hop across on the pads and hope the frogs are not hungry.

outcomes.text: The frogs watch you cross and do nothing.
The frogs are hungry after all, and very quick.

options.label: The kindest tosses them bread to buy their good mood.

outcomes.text: They croak, deep and pleased, then shift aside to open a path.

options.label: Go round the lake, and leave the frogs to their herons.

outcomes.text: The way around is long and wet. The frogs watch you the whole time.
